Commentary.Commentary: UAE were brilliant for the first 5 overs or so but later on, they had no answers to the hitting by the two Indian batters! The ground fielding was also not at its best after that as there were far too many misfields. The bowlers also succumbed under pressure as there were far too many boundary balls. UAE will not be pleased with how thiungs have ended. They have a huge task in hand now and will need a miracle to win from here. India should defend this. Chase in a bit.

That is a brilliant recovery from India and that stand between Deepti Sharma and Jemimah Rodrigues has probably taken the game away from UAE. Let me remind you, India were 19 for 3 but from then on, it was all about the Indians. Deepti Sharma and Jemimah Rodrigues took the attack to the bowlers and really scored freely. Both got up half tons and added over 100. Sharma fell towards the end but Jemimah Rodrigues remained unbeaten. Kiran Navgire and Pooja Vastrakar also played handy cameos to take India up to a very good total.
FOUR! A boundary to end the innings! India end with 178! Fuller and outside off, this is hit hard through extra cover and it races away to the fence.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.

Run out chance but not taken! Kiran Navgire was a goner! Shorter and outside off, Kiran Navgire looks to cut but it goes off the underedge towards short fine leg. Jemimah Rodrigues wants one but Kiran is very late to take off. The keeper has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! Up and over! Kiran Navgire comes down the track, she lifts it over mid off for a boundary. Clever shot.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped towards sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! That is carved away! Lovely shot! A yorker outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues guides it past short third man and this races away to the fence.
Floats it up on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Shorter and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues chops it towards point for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Pooja falls now! She was going after everything and she departs! Pooja Vastrakar steps out, she gets to the pitch of the ball and tonks it down towards long on. The fielder there takes another good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Kavisha Egodage b Esha Oza

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Pooja has come out all guns blazing! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for a boundary.
Outside off, Pooja Vastrakar guides it towards short third man and takes one. The throw is towards the bowler who does not stp it. Another run taken.
SIX! Over the fence! Shorter in length and on middle, Pooja Vastrakar steps out and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.

OUT! TAKEN! That is an outstanding catch! Sharma steps out, she makes it into a full toss and hits it really well towards long on. The fielder there moves to her left, takes it just before the ropes and also keeps her balance brilliantly.
Commentary.Howout: c Mahika Gaur b Suraksha Kotte

Commentary.Commentary: The reverse sweep comes out, it is a little too full, it goes off the underedge towards backward point for one.
FOUR! Three in a row now! Shorter and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues pulls it over square leg and bags another boundary.
FOUR! Two in a row! Another one tossed up and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues yet again nails the sweep, it goes past mid-wicket and into the fence yet again.
FOUR! Misfield and a boundary! On middle, Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it towards square leg. The fielder lets it through and this one races away to the fence.
Just over! Really slow and outside off. Sharma lifts it but it goes more off the toe-end, clears cover and a couple taken.
Outside off, this is hit towards long off for one.
Flatter and outside off, Sharma thumps it past the bowler and down to long off for one.
Outside off, this is guided past point for one more.
Outside off, Deepti Sharma lifts it over cover and takes one.
Floats it up on off, Jemimah Rodrigues lifts it over cover for one.
This time she connects with the paddle scoop, it goes towards fine leg and two is taken.
This is a flighted ball outside off, Deepti Sharma looks to play the paddle scoop but misses. It goes just over the off pole.
Tossed up around off, this is lofted towards sweeper cover. A run taken.
On middle, Sharma plays the paddle scoop, it goes towards short fine leg for one.
Two more! Deepti Sharma comes down the track again and hits it wide of long off for two.
FOUR! Picks the gap! Deepti Sharma steps out and gets to the pitch of the ball, he whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On middle, this is driven but back to the bowler.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Creamed away! Fuller and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues strokes it towards cover. The fielder misfields and it races away to the fence.
Outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues chops it to point.
On middle, this is swept towards deep square leg for one.
Shorter in length and outside off, Sharma cuts but finds point.
SIX! Over the fence! Brings up her fifty in style! Solid knock and at a crucial time! On off, fuller, this is heaved over the long on fence for a biggie.
FOUR! That is a strong shot! On off, this is thumped down the ground for a boundary.
A single! Outside off, this is cut towards point. A misfield sees the batters take one.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Not hit well enough but clears the fielder! Fuller and outside off, this is hit over mid off, not timed well but hit well enough to clear the fielder. Two taken.
Outside off, this is cut through point for two.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Tickled nice and fine! On the middle pole, Jemimah Rodrigues goes down on one knee and plays it fine to the fine leg fence. Boundary. Second in the over.
Shorter and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues cuts but to point.
Another one on the fuller side, Sharma now hits it through covers and takes one.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Lovely placement! On middle, fuller, Jemimah Rodrigues goes down on one knee and plays the paddle scoop, it races away to the fine leg fence.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut towards point. A fumble sees the batter take one.
Fuller again and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues carves it through covers and takes two more.
On middle, Sharma works it through square leg and takes one.
SIX! What a shot that is! Brilliant! Used the angle to perfection! Sharma walks across, this is full and on middle, it is hit over the fine leg fence for a biggie.
Fuller and outside off, this is lofted over cover for one.
A full toss, Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and carves it past point for two.
A full toss on middle, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Shorter and on off, Sharma pulls it wide of long on and takes another single.
Fuller and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues lifts it towards long on, it goes on the bounce to the fielder. One taken.
Shorter and outside off, Sharma chops it towards point and takes one.
Fuller and on middle, Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it past the bowler and down to long off for one.
Outside off, Sharma slashes at it, it goes off the underedge towards cover for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
On off, this is turning back into the batter, Sharma sweeps it towards short fine leg for no runs.
Nicely bowled again! This is given air, it lands on off and turns away. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to drive, it goes off the outside edge towards short third man for one.
Outside off, this is dragged wide of long on for two.
Tosses it up and lands it outside off, it is hit down to long off for one.
Well bowled! Slows it up, bowls it outside off and gets it to turn back in. Sharma looks to sweep but misses.
FOUR! Just over! Sharma is dealing in boundaries! Deepti steps out, she gets to the pitch of it and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter ball, around middle and off. Jemimah Rodrigues miscues her pull shot towards mid-wicket.
Nicely flighted again, slower through the air, fuller ball, around off. Deepti Sharma knocks it past the bowler and towards long off for a single.
Pitched-up delivery, outside off. Deepti Sharma leans in and chips it towards extra cover. The ball lobs up and lands just short of the fielder there.
FOUR! Crunched! Loopy one, full, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma gets down on her knee and sweeps it powerfully towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Fuller ball now, around middle and off, Deepti Sharma prods forward and blocks it out.
Esha Oza begins with a shorter ball, spinning in, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it off the back foot towards mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Up and over! Slower through the air, fuller ball, around middle. Deepti Sharma dances down the track once again, and lifts it wide of long on for a boundary.
Flighted delivery again, full, around middle. Deepti Sharma steps down the pitch and works it away towards mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, fuller one, outside off. Deepti Sharma skips down the pitch and blocks it out.
Back to 'round the wicket for the left-hander, a fuller one again, loopy as well, around middle. Deepti Sharma knocks it to long on for a brace.
A fuller one from over the wicket now, outside off, tossed up as well. Jemimah Rodrigues leans in and drives it through cover for a run.
A loopy ball, slower through the air, around off. Deepti Sharma advances down the pitch and strokes it down to long on for a single.
Pitched up, around off. Deepti Sharma knocks it towards long off and takes a single. 16 runs off the over! A good one for India Women.
Fuller ball, around middle. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it down the ground. Only a single now.

FOUR! Three in a row! This one is the best of the lot! A length ball, around middle and leg. Jemimah Rodrigues presents the full face of the bat and lifts it over the bowler's head for another boundary.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Another pitched-up delivery, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues shuffles across and sweeps it once again this time towards deep square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! In the gap! Much-needed boundary. A fuller ball, around middle and leg. Jemimah Rodrigues gets down on her knee and sweeps this one in the gap between long on and mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma dabs it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! A fuller ball, down the leg side. Deepti Sharma misses her flick. Wide given.
Pitched up, around the leg pole. Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and pushes it to the fielder at mid on. India Women are 27 for 3 at the end of the Powerplay!
Darting this one on the thigh pad, on a length. Jemimah Rodrigues tucks it towards square leg.
A low full toss, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues opens the face of the bat and carves it through cover-point for a brace.
Back of a length, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues gets on top of that one and pushes it towards cover.
On a length, around middle and off. Jemimah Rodrigues leans forward and blocks it out.
Fuller ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma works it away towards mid on for a single.
Wide! Sprays this one down the leg side, Deepti Sharma misses her flick. Wided.
In line with the stumps on a good length, Jemimah Rodrigues clips this to mid-wicket.
Full and just outside off, Deepti Sharma knocks this to long on for a single.
WIDE! This is on a good length and down leg. The umpire calls this wide.
Low full toss outside off, Deepti Sharma mistimes the shot to covers.
Full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues works this wide of mid off and gets off the mark with a single.

RUN OUT! This is proving to be a disaster! India Women are crumbling here. Chaya Mughal bowls this short and wide outside off, Dayalan Hemalatha cuts this towards point and they take two but are looking for the third. Deepti Sharma sees the throw come and sends here partner back. The wicket-keeper whips the stumps and replays show Dayalan Hemalatha is short.
Low full toss outside off, Deepti Sharma knocks the ball to long on and takes one.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Dayalan Hemalatha clips this ball to mid on.
Fuller and outside off, Dayalan Hemalatha works this to the point fielder.
Wide outside off on a good length. Dayalan Hemalatha leaves it alone.

OUT! India Women are in big trouble here! Mahika Gaur bowls this on a good length and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana slashes hard at this and gets a faint edge to the keeper. Theertha Satish takes an easy catch and is jumping up in appeal. The umpire raises his finger and India Women lose their second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Theertha Satish b Mahika Gaur

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off a good length, Deepti Sharma gets a stride forward and works the ball to cover.
Full and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana works this to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Chaya Mughal! Low full toss on the pads, Deepti Sharma sweeps this past short fine leg and collects four runs.
Nipping back in on a good length, Sabbhineni Meghana flicks this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes full and outside off, Deepti Sharma works this to long on for a run.
Pace off this time and really full, Deepti Sharma knocks it back down the pitch.
This is on a good length and just outside off, Deepti Sharma taps it back to the bowler.
Slower delivery bowled full and outside off, Deepti Sharma taps it to the off side,
Outside the off pole on a good length, Deepti Sharma guides this to short third man and takes a single.
Full once again and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana works this wide of cover for a single.
This is on a good length and just outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana blocks this to the off side.
FOUR! That is a delightful-looking shot! Mahika Gaur  bowls this full and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana strokes this to deep cover for four runs.
This is on a good length and in line with the stumps, Sabbhineni Meghana taps this towards point.
Mahika Gaur begins will a full delivery wide outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana strokes this to cover.
Slower delivery bowled on a full length and in line with the stumps, Deepti Sharma digs it out.
OUT! TAKEN! Ghosh goes! What a start for UAE. This is full and angling on middle. Ghosh tries to flick it away but mistimes and it goes to short fine leg where the skipper takes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Priyanjali Jain b Chaya Mughal

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller again. around off. This is pushed past covers for a single.
On middle, kept out.
fuller ball, outside off, pushed to covers.
Flatter and on middle, this is flicked past mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
We are all set. The players are out in the middle. Richa Ghosh and Sabbhineni Meghana will open the batting for India Women. Chaya Mughal will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!

United Arab Emirates Women (Playing XI) - Esha Oza, Theertha Satish (WK), Kavisha Egodage, Natasha Cherriath, Chaya Mughal (C), Khushi Sharma, Priyanjali Jain (In for Lavanya Keny), Samaira Dharnidharka, Vaishnave Mahesh, Mahika Gaur, Suraksha Kotte.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana (C) (In for Shafali Verma), Deepti Sharma, Jemimah Rodrigues, Sabbhineni Meghana, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana (In for Harmanpreet Kaur), Dayalan Hemalatha, Renuka Singh (In for Meghna Singh), Pooja Vastrakar (In for Radha Yadav), Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Kiran Navgire.
TOSS - Smriti Mandhana will lead India today. India Women win the toss and will BAT first!

In space of 24 hours, India are playing another match and they will be confidence to get a result here. They have been dominating in the last two games and will look to do same. Also, let’s hope the rain doesn’t play a part. Toss and team news in a bit…
